t: What he said holding his dying son
a: تَدْمَعُ الْعَيْنُ وَيَحْزَنُ الْقَلْبُ وَلاَ نَقُولُ إِلاَّ مَا يَرْضَى رَبُّنَا إِنَّا بِكَ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَمَحْزُونُونَ
p: Tadmaʿu-l-ʿaynu wa yaḥzanu-l-qalb, wa lā naqūlu illā mā yarḍā rabbunā. Innā bika yā Ibrāhīmu la-maḥzūnūn
m: The eye weeps and the heart grieves, and we say only what our Lord is pleased with. We are grieving for you, Ibrahim.
